turns.text: Thanks for making time, Rob. Last call you mentioned scheduling was the big pain point. Has anything changed since then?
Not really. The front desk is still double-booking hygienists two or three times a week, and we've got four locations now, so it's getting worse.
That's exactly what the multi-location calendar fixes. Did you get a chance to talk budget internally?
Yeah, we did. We have sixty thousand approved for this, for the first year.
Great, that fits the four-location package comfortably. Next step would be a technical deep-dive with our implementation engineer. Could we do Thursday?
Thursday works. Mornings are best for me, so just send whatever morning slot your engineer has.
Will do, I'll get that invite out today.
